change_record.title: There is a new hook data cache service.

description.excerpt: The constructors for the following services have been updated to add HookData and remove the services that are no longer needed. ModuleHandler ThemeHandler Registry There is now a HookData service to manage caching for hooks. Hooks are needed in several different locations. In order to unify how the hooks are retrieved there is a new HookData service. HookData is internal but has two methods: getModuleHookData getThemeHookData

symbols.semantics: A change record names symbols. It does not, in this contract, assert their lifecycle; that comes from the deprecation index.
